name: OMega SWE-Style Real-Repo Coding Benchmark
description: Multi-file bugfix, refactor, concurrency, security, and feature tasks graded with hidden holdout tests.

tasks.title: Enforce token expiration and role checks across auth + middleware
tasks.prompt: Fix the auth module so expired tokens are rejected in src/auth.js and role-based access in src/middleware.js checks requiredRole case-insensitively. Ensure `node test.mjs` passes without breaking existing callers.

tasks.title: Fix LRU recency update on get() and TTL expiration in cache
tasks.prompt: Fix src/lru.js so get() refreshes recency (preventing recently-read keys from being evicted first) and expired TTL entries return undefined and do not count against capacity.

tasks.title: Enforce maxConcurrency and preserve input order in async mapPool
tasks.prompt: Fix mapPool(items, concurrency, worker) in src/pool.js so it never runs more than `concurrency` workers simultaneously, preserves output order matching `items`, and rejects cleanly if any worker throws.

tasks.title: Handle quoted commas, escaped quotes, and CRLF in CSV parser
tasks.prompt: Fix parseCsv(input) in src/csv.js to properly parse RFC-4180 quoted fields containing commas, escaped double quotes (""), embedded newlines inside quotes, and CRLF line endings.

tasks.title: Prevent prototype pollution in deepMerge while preserving nested merge
tasks.prompt: Fix deepMerge(target, source) in src/merge.js so it safely ignores __proto__, constructor, and prototype keys to prevent prototype pollution while still deep-merging plain objects without mutating inputs.

tasks.title: Fix SemVer prerelease precedence across parse.js and compare.js
tasks.prompt: Fix src/parse.js and src/compare.js so SemVer prerelease tags are compared per SemVer 2.0.0 (e.g. 1.0.0-alpha < 1.0.0-alpha.1 < 1.0.0-beta < 1.0.0, numeric identifiers compare numerically).
